about: The owner's 58 choices from the module review, copied unchanged from the review page's store (claude.ai artifact RSVBvxpZqUHbLbePSWyWmB, now locked read-only). 'choice' is final: module = becomes a module; merge = stays part of a bigger module or page; no = not a module. 'plan' is how docs/plans/module-refactor/PLAN.md carries it out and 'deliveredIn' the PR(s) that build it.
approachNote: Not answered yet: page lists as JSON page files in Puck's shape with build-checked rules (recommended) or page lists in code. Needed after Phase 5; work before that is the same either way.
